title: Universal Ores Programmer Art
description: Makes the Universal Ores mod fit in with the Programmer Art style
body:
## Important ⚠️
This rp was created as an integral part of my beta-like [modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/scenery). Please take a look at it
## Why did I do that?
In vanilla Minecraft (both the new and old versions), there was a major issue: the lack of diorite, andesite, tuff, etc.
This resource pack has been created for the Universal Ores mod and allows you to add variety to the game with programmer art
